description: Bulk management + bulk lot generator + bulk listing generator + guarantees, and storage locations (P1 items 15,17; sections 11,12,13,14,21). A dedicated Bulk section with configurable categories (commons, uncommons, regular rares, holos, reverse holos, energy, mixed bulk, playable bulk). A Bulk Lot Generator that analyzes available bulk inventory and proposes lots (e.g. 30x100 / 6x250 / 3x500) with editable quantities. A Bulk Listing Generator that for each lot auto-produces title/description/quantity/suggested price/shipping/SKU/inventory allocation, with configurable lot guarantees (min rares, min holos, no energy, English only, no damaged, no duplicates, mixed sets) that automatically appear in the generated description. Plus a storage-location system (BOX-A / Shelf 2 / Slot 14) so a sold card's physical location is instantly known.
steps: Reminder: zero deps, `unset NODE_OPTIONS`. Depends on FEAT-001 (bulk_lots, inventory_lots, storage_locations, listings tables), FEAT-002 (inventoryRepo, inventory_lots seed data, storageLocationsRepo), FEAT-003 (pricing for suggested lot price), FEAT-005 (skuGenerator, listingsRepo, MarketplacePublisher). Read those first.

src/services/bulkService.ts: (a) getBulkSummary(userId): aggregate bulk holdings by category from inventory rows classified 'Bulk'/status 'Bulk' AND inventory_lots aggregate rows, returning counts + estimated value per category (section 11). (b) generateLots(userId, {category, lotSizes?:number[], targetCounts?}): given available bulk count, propose a packaging plan (e.g. from 3,142 commons -> 30x100 + 6x250 + 3x500 as in section 12), greedily allocating into the requested/default lot sizes and returning proposed BulkLot drafts with card_count each; quantities editable by the seller before commit.

src/repositories/bulkLotsRepo.ts + inventoryLotsRepo.ts: CRUD for bulk_lots (category, card_count, title, description, suggested_price, sku, guarantees_json, status) and inventory_lots aggregates; committing a lot decrements the available bulk pool (update inventory_lots quantity / mark allocated) so counts stay consistent and cards are not double-allocated.

src/services/bulkListingGenerator.ts: for a BulkLot produce a listing draft (reuse FEAT-005 ListingGenerator/listingsRepo patterns): title like 'Pokemon TCG 500 Card Bulk Lot - English Commons Uncommons Rares Holos' (section 13 example), description assembled from the lot contents PLUS any configured guarantees rendered as bullet lines (section 14: 'Minimum X rares', 'English only', 'No energy cards', etc.), quantity=card_count, suggested price from a bulk pricing rule (per-card bulk rate * count, or pricing service), shipping recommendation, SKU via skuGenerator (a bulk SKU variant), and inventory allocation to the lot. Editable before publish; publish via the mock MarketplacePublisher.

src/views/pages/bulk.ts + route GET /bulk: the Bulk section - category summary cards (count + est value per category, section 11), a 'Configure categories' control (which categories are included, persisted to settings), a 'Generate Bulk Lots' action (section 12) opening a proposal screen with editable lot quantities, and a list of existing bulk lots with status + 'Generate Listing' per lot. Guarantee configuration UI (checkboxes/inputs for min rares, min holos, no energy, english only, no damaged, no duplicates, mixed sets) applied to lot generation (section 14).

src/views/pages/storage.ts (or a Settings/Inventory subsection) + routes GET/POST for storage locations: CRUD storage locations (box, shelf, slot, label) per section 21; allow assigning a storage location to inventory rows (and show it on Card Detail + Orders). Ensure the location displays as e.g. 'BOX-A / Shelf 2 / Slot 14'.

src/api/bulk.ts: POST /api/bulk/generate-lots {category, lotSizes[]} (returns proposal), POST /api/bulk/lots (commit chosen lots), PUT /api/bulk/lots/:id (edit qty/guarantees), POST /api/bulk/lots/:id/listing (generate + optionally publish listing), DELETE /api/bulk/lots/:id. src/api/storage.ts: CRUD storage locations + PATCH inventory storage assignment. Session-user scoped, validated.
Wire the Bulk nav item to /bulk; ensure Singles (FEAT-002) vs Bulk views are coherent. Add storage assignment affordances where inventory is shown.

Tests (node:test): src/services/bulkService.test.ts - generateLots on 3,142 commons yields a valid packaging plan whose lot card counts sum to <= available and matches requested sizes (e.g. produces 100/250/500 lots), and committing lots decrements the available pool (no double allocation). src/services/bulkListingGenerator.test.ts - title matches the section-13 bulk pattern, configured guarantees (e.g. min rares, english only, no energy) all appear as lines in the generated description, quantity==card_count, SKU assigned. src/repositories/storage.test.ts - storage CRUD + assignment to inventory is user-scoped and renders as BOX/Shelf/Slot.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build` and `npm test` pass including bulk + storage tests.
The Bulk page shows configurable category summaries with counts and estimated values.

The Bulk Lot Generator proposes lots (e.g. from 3,142 commons into 100/250/500-card lots) with quantities the seller can edit before committing; committing allocates inventory without double-counting.

Each bulk lot generates a listing whose title follows the section-13 pattern and whose description automatically includes all configured guarantees (section 14); quantity equals the lot card count and a SKU is assigned.
Storage locations can be created and assigned to inventory and render as 'BOX-A / Shelf 2 / Slot 14', visible from Card Detail and Orders.
